Container.Name: AuroraBot
Container.Overview: AuroraBot is a Discord bot for eSports fans, focused on Tier 1 / S-tier competition. Follow live scores, current-season standings, deep analytics and match alerts across League of Legends, CS2, Valorant, Dota 2, Rocket League, Rainbow Six and more. Subscribe a channel to a team, a tournament, or a whole game: AuroraBot posts a 30-minute reminder before every match and pings again when it goes live. React to a reminder to predict the winner and climb the server leaderboard. Data is powered by the PandaScore API. Persistent data (SQLite DB + logs) lives in /mnt/user/appdata/aurorabot.
Container.Requires: A Discord bot token and a PandaScore API key.

Config.Name: Discord Bot Token
Config.Description: Your Discord bot token (Developer Portal → Bot → Reset Token).

Config.Name: PandaScore API Key
Config.Description: Your PandaScore API key (pandascore.co → Dashboard → API key).

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite DB inside the container (keep default).

Config.Name: Dev Guild IDs
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated guild IDs for instant command sync while testing. Leave blank for global commands.

Config.Name: Alert Poll Seconds
Config.Description: How often (seconds) to poll PandaScore for live matches.

Config.Name: Alert Lead Minutes
Config.Description: How many minutes before kick-off the match reminder (with winner-prediction reactions) is posted.

Config.Name: Tier 1 Only
Config.Description: Only show top-tier tournaments across scores, alerts, predictions and standings. Set to false to include every tier.

Config.Name: Tier Grades
Config.Description: Which PandaScore tier grades count as Tier 1 (scale S>A>B>C>D). S is majors only (Worlds, MSI, TI, CS Majors); regional leagues like LEC, LCK, LCS and VCT EMEA are graded A — so the default covers both. Use 's' for majors only, or 's,a,b' to widen.

Config.Name: Health Port
Config.Description: Internal health-check port (used by Docker HEALTHCHECK).

Config.Name: AppData (persistent data)
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database and logs.
